description: Sealed response from an external source. Fourth and final event in the four-step egress lineage. MUST reference its egress predecessor via egress_sha. The attribution_chain field is MANDATORY — any downstream citation of this content automatically carries provenance back to original authors/sources.

egress_sha.description: sha_seal of the egress event that fetched this content. chain-invalid if missing.

provenance.description: fixed value — ingested events are typed by construction

source_sha.description: sha256 of the canonical-form fetched content. enables replay-verification and detects upstream content drift.

source_uri.description: URL, DOI, arxiv-id, repo+commit, or canonical identifier of original source

author.description: string or array of author names

venue.description: e.g. journal, conference, book publisher, museum, repo org

license.description: the actual license attached to the source (CC-BY-4.0, MIT, etc)

attribution_chain.description: MANDATORY. Authors and source credits. Every downstream citation of this ingested event automatically traverses this chain. Empty = chain-invalid.
